description: Price a cross-border payment or international wire transfer. Use this when an agent or user needs to know the cost of moving money between countries or currencies — e.g. USD→EUR vendor payment, treasury transfer, foreign payroll, intercompany settlement. Also works for same-currency (domestic) settlements. Returns the all-in fee breakdown (core 1.50%, FX 0.40% if cross-currency, ESG compliance fee 0–0.50%, license 0.01%), net amount the recipient will receive, current oracle stability status, and a quoteId valid for 300 seconds. Always call this before settlement.execute — pass the quoteId to lock in the rate.

esgScore.description: ESG score 0–100. Score 100 = 0% fee. Score 75 = 0.125% fee. Score 0 = 0.50% fee.

hasFx.description: True if source and destination currencies differ (e.g. USD→EUR). Adds 0.40% FX fee.

monthlyVolumeUsd.description: Monthly volume for discount tier. $10M+ = Sovereign (30% off core fee).

name: settlement.quote
